chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: Purpose
chunks.text: The purpose of this change is to provide a provision to request material codes from sourcing team or using previous code mapping.
chunks.locator: § Purpose

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text:
Bill of Material document received from buyer, in general, doesn’t have detailed or proper attributes of Raw materials which is vital for procurement. In these cases, Marketing team requests material code from local sourcing team using existing solution. Sourcing team on receipt of request, either create a new material code or selects the one from existing material codes.
Same process is required in case of automation of BOM here post processing of BOM data, material will either be auto populated based on existing material code mapping, or corresponding BOM line will route to local sourcing team for creation or tagging of existing material.
To route material code request to Souring team, there will be a configuration where admin will be able to mandate material code request based on material categories.
chunks.locator: § Business Requirement

chunks.title: Assumptions
chunks.heading: Assumptions
chunks.text: • This change will not impact existing functionalities.
chunks.locator: § Assumptions

chunks.title: Step 1: Upload and Data Extraction
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › … › Step 1: Upload and Data Extraction
chunks.text: Allow users to upload a buyer’s PDF document containing the article tech pack and BOM data. The system will automatically extract relevant details from the PDF based on predefined mappings.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirements › … › Step 1: Upload and Data Extraction

chunks.title: Functionality
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › … › Step 1: Upload and Data Extraction › Functionality
chunks.text:
• File Upload:
• User uploads the buyer’s PDF document into the system.
• Supported formats: PDF (other formats may be allowed with prior consideration).
• Data Extraction:
• The system extract data from the PDF according to a predefined mapping.
• Extracted data includes:
• Tech Pack Details: Article information, fabric details, style code, etc.
• BOM Information: Materials, component details, supplier, consumption, and placement.
• Activation of Release Option:
• Once data extraction is complete, the Release option becomes active.
• User can click Release to allow the system to move into the review phase.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirements › … › Step 1: Upload and Data Extraction › Functionality

chunks.title: User Interface:
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › … › Step 1: Upload and Data Extraction › User Interface:
chunks.text:
• File Upload Area: Located at the top of the screen, the user can drag-and-drop or browse to upload the PDF.
• Progress Indicator: Shows extraction status (e.g., "Extracting Tech Pack", "Extracting BOM").
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirements › … › Step 1: Upload and Data Extraction › User Interface:

chunks.title: Step 3: Data Validation Screen : This screen data will get it automatically processed for BOM
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › … › Step 3: Data Validation Screen : This screen data will get it automatically processed for BOM
chunks.text:
The purpose of the screen to enable user to review & validate the data extracted from the PDF and make any required edits or selections for the transactions.
Users should have the option to choose the transaction type (Techpack & Sales Order)for which they want to review the extracted data .
Based on the selected transaction type, users can view and verify the data according to its status—such as Completed, In Queue, etc.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirements › … › Step 3: Data Validation Screen : This screen data will get it automatically processed for BOM

chunks.title: Step 4: WFX Article Tech Pack Review and Master Data Mapping
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › … › Step 4: WFX Article Tech Pack Review and Master Data Mapping
chunks.text: Provide users with a detailed review of the tech pack and enable mapping of articles to ensure data is correct and ready for approval.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirements › … › Step 4: WFX Article Tech Pack Review and Master Data Mapping

chunks.title: Functionality
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › … › Step 4: WFX Article Tech Pack Review and Master Data Mapping › Functionality
chunks.text:
• Tech Pack Review:
• The system provides a preview of the WFX article tech pack details.
• Articles are listed in a "Progress" state, indicating that they are being reviewed or pending approval.
Submit Button: Once all data is mapped and confirmed, the user clicks a “Submit” button will create to Style techpack in WFX.
As per the business requirement, on confirmation of apparel category Techpack, system will automatically process the BOM data. Data will be added under material tab in save mode.
We also need to add the Article description column in the BOM which also should be configurable through the SLC and configurator view.
In this process, if the merchant confirms that the article extracted from the source already exists in the master list, the user will have the option that we already have where we can replace the existing article with the new one.
Screenshot attached for the reference.
In the Package, we also need to introduce the following:
• Rule: This should be configuration in the package (Route through backend process only)
This configuration will have two options, and based on the selected option, the system will route the material creation activity.
a. Manual: The user will request material code creation through the BOM only.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirements › … › Step 4: WFX Article Tech Pack Review and Master Data Mapping › Functionality

chunks.title: Functionality
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › … › Step 4: WFX Article Tech Pack Review and Master Data Mapping › Functionality
chunks.text:
b. Auto: If rule is configured, the system will automatically route the request to the material code creation list based on the selected user.
• Purchase Office:
In this column, we will define the username, and based on this, the system will send the material code request to the respective list.
This should be configured through package configuration.
As part of this package configuration, we are introducing an Article column. This will allow the user to select a generic article for any BOM item that either does not have an assigned article or does not exist in the WFX master database.
This enhancement ensures that BOM entries can still be processed even when the corresponding article is missing from the master list. Instead of leaving the field blank or causing validation issues, the user can assign a suitable generic article, enabling smoother data management.
Purchase office should be filter out in this.
A Material Code Request Form must be introduced, allowing users to review and confirm article details extracted from the Techpack before submitting them for approval.
We also need an option to send the material code creation request in the line level and bottom tool (same like cons. & price request) where user can send the request to the user to approver then after it will be reflected in the Material Code request list.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirements › … › Step 4: WFX Article Tech Pack Review and Master Data Mapping › Functionality (part 2)

chunks.title: Functionality
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › … › Step 4: WFX Article Tech Pack Review and Master Data Mapping › Functionality
chunks.text:
We also need to introduce the permission in the of Material Code Request where we can set the permission and also can configure the approver user name to send the request.
Additionally, a new column named “Article Description” should be added in the BOM. This column will initially carry the data from article description from the API, Article code and article name columns will remain blank. Once the article creation request is approved, the system will automatically populate the Article name & Code with the confirmed article name, ensuring the BOM reflects the updated and approved article information.
We are providing the Material code request form: -
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirements › … › Step 4: WFX Article Tech Pack Review and Master Data Mapping › Functionality (part 3)

UI Correction: For the below given screenshot.
In the header, we need three tools:
• OK: This will be used when the user wants to select and replace the article with an existing one.
• New: This should open the Techpack creation form based on the category selected in the line. The user can then create the article Techpack by entering the necessary information and also need an field option where user can select the catalog folder path of that particular article.
• Close: To close the pop-up.

chunks.title: Approval Logic
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › Material Code Request-List › Approval Logic
chunks.text:

• Once the approver confirms the article through the material code mapping, the system will automatically replace it with generic article code and article name and display the article code and name in the BOM/Costing.

chunks.title: Mapping List
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › Material Code Request-List › MRP Restriction › Mapping List
chunks.text:
All mapping defined by sourcing team, will be list under material code mapping list which can be edited by permitted users if required.
In case of subsequent, BOM data processing if material mapping exists in this list then system should auto-populate mapped material code but that listing also need approval from sourcing team as explained in above workflow.
Note : This should be work in the New BOM and Costsheet 4.0 version as well.
